nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: Sampler / Scheduler
widgets_values:
euler / res_multistep are the two main samplers.

Use Simple scheduler for most things. Beta produces bad audio quality. Normal seems to be good on euler.
If you are not running cu130 (cuda 13.0) you are effectively halving your gen speed using the best version of the model (int8 convrot). Make sure to update!

nodes.title: Prompting Guide
widgets_values:
https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md

ref2va is EXTREMELY programmatic. Meaning, the instructions you give must be accurate for consistent results. Use the above guide to reference the instructional keywords/tags for use in your own prompts. You can be creative and use natural language for most situations.

Example prompt:
"A cinematic film scene. <Subject 1> is the girl in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. Use <Picture 3> as a scene background reference. Use <Audio 1> as <Subject 1>'s dialogue in the video.
[Shot 1] A front view close up of <Subject 1>'s face as she speaks saying the line of dialogue in <Audio 1>, fully_copy: "The muffins are cold now." Her face adopts a sad expression.
[Shot 2] At 00:05, a wide shot in profile view of <Subject 1> lifting the plate of muffins and beginning to walk towards the kitchen as the camera follows her movement.
[Shot 3] At 00:09, a high angle close up from behind showing <Subject 1> in the kitchen opening the oven to put the tray of muffins inside on the oven rack."

Does it have to be as complicated as that? Not really. But according to the prompting guide, the model likes firm instructions like this.

nodes.title: Click "Manual Random Seed" to start Gens!
CUSTOM NODES
widgets_values:
.: Sol-Attn
https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton

Works in conjunction with Sage Attention, it's Kijai's newest node meant to improve gen speed.
Requires triton to be installed.

-------------------------------

.: Spectrum
https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3

Spectrum is slower but better quality.
Do NOT combine with EasyCache. One or the other!

-------------------------------

Download the Zip files and extract into:
ComfyUI_windows_portable\ComfyUI\custom_nodes\ folder.

Or go into custom_nodes folder and open CMD prompt and type:
git clone https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3
(or whatever node's url you're trying to install)

I2V / FFLF uses <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>
For T2V just disable both <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> in the REFERENCE CONTROL PANEL toggle section.

nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
If picture 1 was a character ref sheet and audio 1 is a line of dialogue:
A realistic cinematic shot. <Subject 1> is the girl in <Picture 1>. 
A high angle medium shot of <Subject 1> as she leans forward on the balcony facing the camera. The camera pulls in towards a close up of her face. She turns her head side to side looking over her shoulders with a suspicious expression, making sure no one else is around. Afterwards she turns her head back to face the camera, making eye contact with the camera. She speaks the dialogue in <Audio 1> fully_copy: "My muffins are getting cold."

----

If you want to replace a character in video 1 with a character from picture 1:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace the girl in <Video 1> with the exact blonde haired girl in <Picture 1>.

---- 

If you want to continue a video:
[video continuation] The target video continues from the last frames of <Video 1>

----

Read the prompt guide below for more!~
